mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_artifact_stage (stage_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, execution_id, workspace_key, file_name, sha256, content_bytes, status, expires_at, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{userId}, #{scopeId}, #{bindingId}, #{executionId}, #{workspaceKey}, #{fileName}, #{hash}, #{content}, 'STAGED', #{expiresAt}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT stage_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, execution_id, workspace_key, file_name, sha256, content_bytes AS content, status, artifact_id FROM sq_artifact_stage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stage_id = #{stageId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT stage_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, execution_id, workspace_key, file_name, sha256, content_bytes AS content, status, artifact_id FROM sq_artifact_stage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stage_id = #{stageId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT stage_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, execution_id, workspace_key, file_name, sha256, content_bytes AS content, status, artifact_id FROM sq_artifact_stage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND workspace_key = #{workspaceKey} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_artifact_stage SET status = 'COMMITTED', artifact_id = #{artifactId}, content_bytes = X'', last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stage_id = #{stageId} AND status = 'STAGED' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sq_artifact SET del_flag = '1', last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE sq_scope_artifact SET del_flag = '1' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_artifact a WHERE a.user_id = sq_scope_artifact.user_id AND a.artifact_id = sq_scope_artifact.artifact_id AND a.del_flag = '1')
UPDATE sq_task_artifact SET del_flag = '1' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_artifact a WHERE a.user_id = sq_task_artifact.user_id AND a.artifact_id = sq_task_artifact.artifact_id AND a.del_flag = '1')

UPDATE sq_message_artifact SET del_flag = '1' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_artifact a WHERE a.user_id = sq_message_artifact.user_id AND a.artifact_id = sq_message_artifact.artifact_id AND a.del_flag = '1')

UPDATE sq_artifact SET content_bytes = X'' WHERE del_flag = '1' AND OCTET_LENGTH(content_bytes) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_scope_artifact r WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND r.del_flag = '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_task_artifact r WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND r.del_flag = '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_message_artifact r WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND r.del_flag = '0')
UPDATE sq_artifact_stage SET status = 'EXPIRED', del_flag = '1', content_bytes = X'' WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND status = 'STAGED'
